title: Level 1 frame and resource entries batch 1

0x4f63ec.name: operator new
0x4f63ec.reason: the C runtime heap ends in operating-system calls

equivalent_mutants.reason: The private iterator vtable at +0 is never read by either owned traversal or original begin/advance. Shifting this store to +4 is immediately overwritten by the next initializer and then by 0x4f48b9. This ordinary family exposes heap/global effects and callback operands, not the private iterator stack frame; final private-stack residue is outside that comparison contract. Checked against 0x4f4860, 0x4f48a0 and 0x4f49c0 instructions and the exact mutant hash.

Original begin overwrites iterator+4 at 0x4f48b9 unconditionally before every early exit or use. Shifting the zero store to +8 duplicates the next initializer; advance also overwrites +8 at 0x4f49c9 before reading it. This ordinary family exposes heap/global effects and callback operands, not the private iterator stack frame; final private-stack residue is outside that comparison contract. Checked against 0x4f4860, 0x4f48a0 and 0x4f49c0 instructions and the exact mutant hash.
